title: Use list comprehension to create squares from 1 to 1 and print the list. (Challenge 1)
description: Use list comprehension to create squares from 1 to 1 and print the list.
hints: Identify the main Python concept: list comprehension.
Write a small, direct solution and check indentation.
Compare each printed line with the expected output.
solution:
squares = [x*x for x in range(1, 2)]
print(squares)
explanation: This exercise practices list comprehension. The solution uses the relevant Python feature and prints the required result.
commonMistakes: Forgetting correct indentation or punctuation.
Printing extra text that changes the expected output.
